author: Jason Turner & Mathieu Ropert
description:
In this episode, Mathieu and Jason are joined by Ryan Keane to discuss his duck library, which allows polymorphism-like behaviour through reflection, along with his journey of learning C++ through exploring C++26's reflection mechanisms.

Links

  • rjk::duck - Zero boilerplate generic type erasure, powered by C++26 reflection - Ryan Keane
  • Beautiful Type Erasure with C++26 Reflection - Ryan Keane
  • A Duck Does More Than Quack: Synthesizing VTables with C++26 Reflection - Ryan Keane (CppCon 2026)
  • P4148: protocol: Structural Subtyping for C++ - Jonathan Coe et al.
title: Learning C++ With C++26's Reflection
